evidence_excerpts: These changes were sustained 6 months after the ceremony (t(121) = 5.07, p < 0.0001, d = 0.46, 95% CI [0.22, 0.50]).
The observed changes were enduring, persisting for up to 6 months in most domains, with the exception of fatalistic determinism.
text: Most psychedelic-associated shifts in non-physicalist metaphysical beliefs persisted for at least six months, while fatalistic determinism was less durable in the overall observational sample.
